faq.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
faq.a: No. Most of our clients give us a door code, lockbox or key, all logged in a chain-of-custody record. You'll get a text when the crew arrives, and before/after photos in your account when they finish.

By your home size tier and how often we visit — not by the hour. You see the exact total before you confirm and it does not change unless you ask us to do more. First visits are priced as a deep clean to bring the home to a maintainable baseline.

faq.q: Why is the first clean more expensive?
faq.a: A first visit is priced as a deep clean, about 35% above your recurring rate. It covers the built-up work a maintenance visit doesn't reach — baseboards, grout, inside appliances, vents. Every visit after that is at your normal recurring price.

faq.q: Do you bring your own supplies?
faq.a: Yes, at no extra charge. HEPA backpack vacuums, a color-coded microfiber system laundered between every job, and EPA Safer Choice certified concentrates. If you'd rather we use your products, leave them out and note it on your booking.

We're fully insured before your first clean, so your home is covered from the very first visit. Every cleaner is an experienced independent contractor we vet personally and hold to a written service agreement before their first job.

faq.q: Will I get the same cleaners each visit?
faq.a: For recurring clients, yes. We assign a dedicated two-person team so they learn your home and your preferences. If someone is out, we brief the replacement with your notes and photos first.
Tell us within 24 hours and we re-clean it free. That's our rescue protocol and there are no questions asked. Our owner also personally walks through your first and fourth visits.
Residential service is month-to-month. Reschedule or cancel free up to 48 hours before your visit from the app or by phone. Inside 48 hours a fee applies because the crew's time is already reserved.
Residential clients are charged to a saved card on the day of service. Commercial accounts are invoiced net-15. We accept all major cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

faq.q: Do you handle vacation rental turnovers?
faq.a: It's one of our specialties. We run a 28-point turnover checklist with full linen re-set, consumable restocking, photo verification and a same-day SLA inside your check-out/check-in window, seven days a week in peak season.

Cleaning of residential dwellings is exempt from Florida sales tax under F.S. 212.05, so your home cleaning has no tax added. Commercial and non-dwelling cleaning is taxable and shows the tax line on your invoice.

We cover four markets: Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater and Sarasota, along with the communities around each — South Tampa, Westchase, Brandon, Riverview, Snell Isle, Pinellas Park, Gulfport, St. Pete Beach, Treasure Island, Largo, Seminole, Dunedin, Safety Harbor, Siesta Key, Longboat Key and Lakewood Ranch. We're based in Tampa. A small drive-time surcharge applies to the farthest beach, eastern and Sarasota addresses. If you're just outside, call us — we can often still make it work.
If a storm closes the area we contact you to reschedule at no charge, and we prioritize getting your recurring slot back first. We also offer post-storm cleanup as a separate service.

service_agreement.intro: This agreement is between you (the client) and Tampa Maids Cleaning. You accept it when you confirm a booking. We keep a record of the version you accepted and when.

sections.title: Who performs the work
sections.body: Cleanings are carried out by experienced independent contractors engaged by Tampa Maids Cleaning, not by our employees. We select each cleaner personally, require them to sign a written service agreement, and hold them to our written checklist and supply standards. Contractors control the manner and means of their work.

sections.title: What's included
sections.body: Your booking covers the service and any add-ons shown on your confirmation, to the published checklist for that service. Anything outside that scope is quoted separately and never added to your bill without your approval first.

sections.title: Equipment and products
sections.body: Contractors supply their own professional-grade equipment and products. We require, as a condition of their agreement with us, HEPA-filtration vacuums, a colour-coded microfiber system laundered between jobs, and EPA Safer Choice certified chemistries. Tell us before your visit if you'd prefer we use products you supply, or need a fragrance-free visit.

sections.title: Price and payment
sections.body: Your price is flat and shown in full before you book. It does not change unless you ask us to do more. Residential visits are charged on the day of service. Commercial accounts are invoiced net-15. Florida sales tax does not apply to cleaning of residential dwellings; it does apply to commercial work and is shown separately.

sections.title: Rescheduling and cancellation
sections.body: Reschedule or cancel free up to 48 hours before your visit, from the app or by phone. Inside 48 hours a cancellation fee applies, because the cleaner's time is already reserved and they are paid for the reserved slot. If we cannot reach your property because of a lockout, an incorrect code, or an unsafe condition, that counts as a late cancellation.

sections.title: Access to your home
sections.body: Access details you give us — codes, lockbox locations, key handling instructions — are recorded in a chain-of-custody log and shared only with the contractor assigned to your job. Keys are never labelled with your address. Tell us promptly when a code changes.

sections.title: Our 24-hour re-clean guarantee
sections.body: If something was missed or isn't right, tell us within 24 hours of the visit and we will re-clean the affected areas at no charge. This is our primary remedy and we would rather fix it than argue about it.

sections.title: Damage and breakage
sections.body: Report any damage or breakage within 48 hours of the visit so we can investigate while the facts are fresh, and keep the item if you can. We carry liability coverage for damage caused by our contractors' work. We are not responsible for pre-existing damage, normal wear, failure of items already loose, broken or improperly installed, or deterioration that cleaning reveals rather than causes.

sections.title: Items of extraordinary value
sections.body: Please secure cash, jewellery, firearms, collectibles, irreplaceable documents and similar items before your visit, or tell us which areas to skip. We ask contractors not to handle them.

sections.title: Things we don't do
sections.body: For safety and insurance reasons contractors do not climb above two-step height, move furniture heavier than roughly 35 lb, handle biohazards, pet or human waste, mould remediation, or pest infestations, or clean exterior windows above ground floor. We'll tell you if something falls outside scope and offer an alternative.

sections.title: Photos
sections.body: Contractors take before and after photos for your record and for quality checks. We do not use photos of your home in marketing without asking you first.

sections.title: Hiring our contractors directly
sections.body: Please don't engage a cleaner we introduced you to outside Tampa Maids Cleaning for 12 months after your last visit. Finding, vetting and scheduling them is the service you're paying for. If you'd like to work with someone directly, talk to us and we'll sort out a referral fee rather than lose you as a client.

sections.title: Ending service
sections.body: Residential service is month-to-month with no contract and no cancellation penalty beyond the 48-hour window above. Cancel any time from the app or by phone.
